name: gestao-financeira-workspace
description: Root workspace to start both frontend and backend

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix gestao-financeira-api && npm install --prefix gestao-financeira
scripts.dev:backend: npm run prisma:migrate --prefix gestao-financeira-api && npm run prisma:seed --prefix gestao-financeira-api && npm run dev --prefix gestao-financeira-api
scripts.start: npx --yes concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
